selectorPolicy: Use source-owned data-role or data-action-id markers; runtime selectors use the corresponding wx-data marker class.

interactions.name: open an available news metric
interactions.precondition: at least one metric is available
interactions.expected: navigate to news_list with the selected category

interactions.name: open the class selector and choose one canonical class
interactions.precondition: the route has at least two enabled canonical classes and exactly one selected class
interactionSequence: tap one enabled class cell whose key differs from selectedClassKey
interactions.expected: the class sheet closes, the selector pill updates, and exactly one class cell owns selected material without changing any class-cell or selector-pill bounds

interactions.name: open the first enabled workbench module
interactions.precondition: at least one module is enabled
interactions.expected: navigate to the module route without changing the selected specialization

interactions.name: toggle news ordering
interactions.precondition: news list has completed initial loading
interactions.expected: sort direction and visible feed order change while shared chrome remains fixed

interactions.name: collapse and expand article evidence
interactions.expected: evidence body visibility toggles without moving the page header

interactions.name: open a build evidence simulator
interactions.precondition: the first card primary action is enabled
interactions.expected: navigate to talent_simulator for the card specialization

interactions.name: open the template import overlay
interactions.precondition: talent route has completed initial loading
interactions.expected: saved and backend-selected community template tabs are visible; a stale community winner is explicitly labelled and remains importable

interactions.name: choose a candidate, choose a returned variant when present, then explicitly apply it
interactions.precondition: a compact slot group has returned at least one candidate and any legal variant options from the canonical backend
interactionSequence: choose one returned variant when present and record its variant key
interactions.expected: candidate and variant clicks remain local draft changes; only explicit apply after the current verified resolvedSlots item and variant identities exactly match the selected candidate updates the equipped slot, while enhancement drafts remain covered by the separately frozen manual acceptance item gear_enhancement_confirm

interactions.name: open the owner's conversation archive
interactions.precondition: the Captain root page is interactive
interactions.expected: navigate to chickenbro_chat without creating or changing a session

interactions.name: open SimC submission records
interactions.expected: navigate to tasks_list without submitting a task

interactions.name: restore one archived conversation
interactions.precondition: a real owner-isolated session row is available and no selection is loading
interactions.expected: store only the selected session id, return to simulator_home, then render that session's full server-backed history

interactions.name: toggle owner task ordering
interactions.precondition: task list has completed initial loading
interactions.expected: sort label and record order toggle without changing task facts

interactions.name: refresh the same task
interactions.precondition: task detail refresh action is enabled
interactions.expected: only the current task id reloads and existing content remains during refresh

interactions.name: open the first template category
interactions.expected: navigate to talent_simulator without changing the saved template library
